name: Outlook backfill sync
description: Message-based Outlook backfill into Tenant Data. Requires backfill_after start date. Re-run while backfill_status=running.

steps.name: Build list messages args
steps.script:
local row = {}
if steps.read_sync_state.result and steps.read_sync_state.result.row then
  row = steps.read_sync_state.result.row
end
local after = input.backfill_after or row.backfill_after or "2026-01-01"
local filter = "receivedDateTime ge " .. after .. "T00:00:00Z"
return {
  folder_id = row.inbox_folder_id or "",
  filter = filter,
  top = 50,
  connection_id = row.connection_id or input.connection_id or "",
  inbox_folder_id = row.inbox_folder_id,
  mailbox_email = row.mailbox_email,
  backfill_after = after,
  poll_interval_seconds = row.poll_interval_seconds or 120,
}

for_each_body_steps.name: Map conversation and message rows
for_each_body_steps.script:
local m = steps.get_message.result.message
return {
  conversation_row = {
    external_id = run.external_id,
    conversation_id = m.conversation_id,
    subject = m.subject,
    preview = m.body_preview,
    participants = { m.from },
    message_count = 1,
    last_message_at = m.received_date_time,
    is_read = m.is_read,
    synced_at = input.synced_at,
    source = "backfill",
  },
  message_row = {
    external_id = run.external_id,
    message_id = m.id,
    conversation_id = m.conversation_id,
    subject = m.subject,
    from_email = m.from,
    to_email = m.to,
    cc_email = m.cc,
    body_preview = m.body_preview,
    has_attachments = m.has_attachments,
    is_read = m.is_read,
    is_draft = m.is_draft,
    parent_folder_id = m.parent_folder_id,
    received_at = m.received_date_time,
    is_deleted = false,
    synced_at = input.synced_at,
    source = "backfill",
  },
}

steps.name: Update backfill checkpoint
steps.script:
local lm = steps.list_messages.result
local status = "complete"
local page = nil
if lm.has_more and lm.next_page_url and lm.next_page_url ~= "" then
  status = "running"
  page = lm.next_page_url
end
local bq = steps.build_list_args.result or {}
return {
  external_id = run.external_id,
  connection_id = bq.connection_id or input.connection_id or "",
  mailbox_email = bq.mailbox_email,
  inbox_folder_id = bq.inbox_folder_id,
  delta_link = "",
  backfill_status = status,
  backfill_page_token = page,
  backfill_after = bq.backfill_after,
  last_sync_at = input.synced_at,
  poll_interval_seconds = bq.poll_interval_seconds or 120,
}
